gloss: joint, knot; tune, melody; point, moment

definitions.explanation: A point where segments connect, such as bamboo joints or finger joints.
A musical melody or the way something is sung.
A particular instance or aspect of something.

examples.english: You can see the joints of the bamboo.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{板|いた}→いた：01792_ita⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{節|ふし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}くて→おおい：01127_ooi⟧⟦{使|つか}い→つかう：00473_tsukau⟧⟦にくい→にくい：02005_nikui⟧。

notes:
Multiple meanings centered around points of connection or division.

MEANING 1 - JOINTS/KNOTS:
- ⟦{竹|たけ}→たけ：02220_take⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{節|ふし} (bamboo joint)
- ⟦{指|ゆび}→ゆび：01518_yubi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{節|ふし} (finger joint/knuckle)
- ⟦{木|き}→き：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{節|ふし} (knot in wood)

MEANING 2 - MELODY:
- {節|ふし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧ (to set to a tune)
- ⟦{節回|ふしまわ}し→ふしまわし：noentry⟧ (way of singing, melody style)

MEANING 3 - POINT/ASPECT:
- 〜{節|ふし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is an aspect of ~)
- ⟦{不審|ふしん}な→ふしん：16934_fushin⟧{節|ふし} (suspicious points)

HOMOPHONE (different reading):
- ⟦{節|せつ}→せつ：19359_setsu⟧ - section, clause; season
